Once obtained, prepare to destroy your perception through careful dosing. Ingest the substance and surrender as reality fragments: walls may breathe, colors scream, and time loops endlessly, effectively destroying any anchor to the tangible world.

To deepen the destruction, combine seeking hallucinogens with sensory deprivation techniques. Lie still as perceptions warp—friends might morph into monsters, and self-identity dissolves into a void. Repeat this process regularly to ensure lasting erosion of reality's hold, turning temporary breaks into permanent perceptual ruin.
